title: mri_watershed
description: A tool for stripping skull and other non-brain tissues to produce brain volume from T1 volume.

output_volume.description: Output volume (e.g., skull stripped brain volume)
output_volume.title: Output Volume

weight.description: Preweight the input image using atlas information
weight.title: Weight

no_wta_flag.description: Don't use the preweighting for the template deformation
no_wta_flag.title: No WTA Flag

proba_merging.description: Use the basins merging using atlas information
proba_merging.title: Proba Merging

no_seedpt_flag.description: Don't use seedpoints using atlas information
no_seedpt_flag.title: No Seedpoint Flag

no_ta_flag.description: Don't use template deformation using atlas information
no_ta_flag.title: No TA Flag

copy_flag.description: Just copy input to output, ignore other options
copy_flag.title: Copy Flag

atlas_flag.description: Use the atlas information to correct the segmentation
atlas_flag.title: Atlas Flag

surf_name.description: Save the BEM surfaces; use consistent coordinates with tkmedit
surf_name.title: Surface Name

usesurf_ras_flag.description: Use the surface RAS coordinates for surfaces
usesurf_ras_flag.title: Use Surface RAS Flag

no_t1_analysis_flag.description: Don't do T1 analysis, useful when running out of memory
no_t1_analysis_flag.title: No T1 Analysis Flag

wat_temp_flag.description: Use watershed algorithm and first template smoothing
wat_temp_flag.title: Watershed and Template Flag

first_temp_flag.description: Use only the first template smoothing + local matching
first_temp_flag.title: First Template Flag

surf_debug_flag.description: Visualize the surfaces onto the output volume
surf_debug_flag.title: Surface Debug Flag

shrink_brain_surf.description: Save the brain surface shrank inward by a specified mm
shrink_brain_surf.title: Shrink Brain Surface

seed_point.description: Add a seed point as a 3D coordinate
seed_point.title: Seed Point

center_brain.description: Specify the center of the brain (voxel coordinates)
center_brain.title: Center Brain

brain_radius.description: Specify the radius of the brain (voxel units)
brain_radius.title: Brain Radius

watershed_threshold.description: Change the threshold in the watershed process
watershed_threshold.title: Watershed Threshold

no_watershed_analysis_flag.description: Don't use the watershed analysis process
no_watershed_analysis_flag.title: No Watershed Analysis Flag

label_flag.description: Labelize the output volume into scalp, skull, csf, gray, and white matter
label_flag.title: Label Flag

manual_params.description: Change parameters csf_max, transition intensity, and GM_intensity
manual_params.title: Manual Params

xthresh.description: Remove voxels whose intensity exceeds the specified threshold
xthresh.title: X Threshold

mask_flag.description: Mask a volume with the brain mask
mask_flag.title: Mask Flag
